		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl

	left join

		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null

		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)

	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 21 and 22
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 21:10:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC

)

/* cppi::e6224fccfd812d39e35393af7a91fcc31a1d30c4cf82f606b4bac7fa5e8d6b31 */
select distinct a.*, b.*, c.*, d.*, e.*, f.*, p.*, u.*, up.*, uf.*
from
(
    select LOT.broker_id_type,
           LOT.broker_name,
           LOT.broker_source_id_type,
           LOT.brokerage_fee_amount,
           LOT.brokerage_fee_amount_currency,
           LOT.business_date,
           LOT.contract_month,
           LOT.current_contract_id,
           LOT.current_price,
           LOT.current_price_currency,
           LOT.custody_account_code,
           LOT.deal_type,
           LOT.delta,
           LOT.fx_rate_base_currency,
           LOT.fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
           LOT.fx_rate_quoted_in_usd,
           LOT.gamma,
           LOT.id_broker,
           LOT.id_broker_source,
           LOT.id_instrument,
           LOT.id_instrument_alternate,
           LOT.id_sub_trade_source,
           LOT.instrument_alternate_id_type,
           LOT.instrument_family_name_source,
           LOT.instrument_group_name_source,
           LOT.instrument_id_type,
           LOT.instrument_last_tradeable_date,
           LOT.instrument_lot_size,
           LOT.instrument_name,
           LOT.instrument_option_expiry_date,
           LOT.instrument_option_type,
           LOT.instrument_strike_price,
           LOT.instrument_strike_price_currency,
           LOT.instrument_sub_type,
           LOT.instrument_type,
           LOT.market_value,
           LOT.market_value_currency,
           LOT.past_cash_flows_proceeds,
           LOT.past_cash_flows_proceeds_currency,
           LOT.premium_amount,
           case
               when LOT.instrument_family_name_source = 'IRD' then
                   abs(LOT.quantity) * abs(LOT.instrument_lot_size)
               else
                   abs(LOT.quantity) * abs(LOT.instrument_lot_size) * LOT.underlying_current_price
               end
           as current_nominal,
           case
               when LOT.instrument_family_name_source = 'IRD' then
                   LOT.fx_rate_quoted_in_cad * abs(LOT.quantity) * abs(LOT.instrument_lot_size)
               else
                   LOT.fx_rate_quoted_in_cad * abs(LOT.quantity) * abs(LOT.instrument_lot_size) * LOT.underlying_current_price
               end
           as current_nominal_pc,
           LOT.market_value + LOT.future_cash_flows  as clean_market_value,
           (LOT.market_value + LOT.future_cash_flows) * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad  as clean_market_value_pc,
           LOT.market_value                          as market_value_mv,
           LOT.market_value * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad  as market_value_base_mv,
           LOT.current_price_currency                as current_notional_currency,
           LOT.market_value_currency,
           LOT.premium_amount_currency,
           LOT.premium_payment_date,
           LOT.previous_price_currency,
           LOT.quantity,
           LOT.rho,
           LOT.settlement_date,
           LOT.sub_trade_source_id_type,
           LOT.theta,
           LOT.trade_date,
           LOT.trade_id,
           LOT.trade_price,
           LOT.trade_price_currency,
           LOT.trade_status,
           LOT.trade_strategy_name,
           LOT.trader_name,
           LOT.trading_portfolio_code,
           LOT.underlying_current_price,
           LOT.vanna,
           LOT.vega,
           LOT.future_cash_flows
    FROM trades_deals.listed_options_trades LOT
    WHERE business_date = date '2025-06-26'
    and id_instrument !='0'
) as a
left join
(
    select id_instrument,
           LOP.instrument_type_name_source       AS Position_instrument_type_name_source,
           LOP.underlying_current_price_currency AS Position_underlying_current_price_currency
    FROM trades_deals.listed_options_positions  LOP
    WHERE business_date = date '2025-06-26'
    and id_instrument !='0'
) as b
    on a.id_instrument = b.id_instrument
left join
(
    select cast(cppib_sec_id as VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new,
           underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id,
           expiration_date,
           exercise_type,
           instrument_description,
           exchange_name,
           country_code,
           ticker,
           underlying_instrument_bloomberg_unique_id,
           underlying_instrument_currency_code,
           underlying_instrument_isin,
           underlying_instrument_spot_ticker,
           underlying_instrument_ticker,
           underlying_instrument_ticker_exchange_code,
           underlying_instrument_warrant_underlying_type,
           sub_type,
           mic,
           region_code,
           market_sector_description,
           bloomberg_exchange,
           document_type,
           bloomberg_unique_id,
           currency_code,
           delete_date,
           expiration_date
    from asset.asset_options
    where business_date = date '2025-06-26'
) as c
    on a.id_instrument = c.cppib_sec_id_new
left join
(
    select trading_portfolio_code,
           id_model_portfolio
    from finance_accounting.murex_scd_model_portfolios_mapping
      where business_date = date '2025-06-26'
) as d
    on d.trading_portfolio_code = a.trading_portfolio_code
left join
(
    select id_model_portfolio,
           unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
    from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
    where business_date = date '2025-06-26'
) as e
    on d.id_model_portfolio = e.id_model_portfolio
left join
(
    select cppib_sec_id,
           cppib_currency_of_exposure_code
    from asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
    where business_date = date '2025-06-26'
) as f
    on cast(f.cppib_sec_id as varchar) = a.id_instrument
left join
(
    select cppib_party_id,
           party_name,
           domicile_country_code,
           incorp_country_code,
           bloomberg_company_id
    from party.party
    where business_date = date '2025-06-26'
) as p
    on cast(p.cppib_party_id as varchar) = a.id_broker
left join
(
    select sub_type as underlying_instrument_sub_type,
           type as underlying_instrument_type,
           exchange_name as underlying_instrument_exchange_name,
           mic as underlying_instrument_mic,
           country_code as underlying_instrument_country_code,
           last_tradeable_date as underlying_instrument_maturity_date,
           instrument_description as underlying_instrument_description,
           instrument_name as underlying_instrument_name,
           region_code as underlying_instrument_region_code,
           market_sector_description as underlying_instrument_market_sector,
           contract_size as underlying_instrument_contract_size,
           bloomberg_exchange as underlying_instrument_bloomberg_exchange,
           cppib_party_id as underlying_cppib_party_id,
           cppib_sec_id as underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id,
           delete_date as underlying_delete_date,
           last_delivered_date as last_delivered_date
    from asset.asset_futures
    where business_date = date '2025-06-26'
) as u
    on u.underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id = c.underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id
left join
(
    select cppib_party_id as u_cppib_party_id,
           party_name as u_party_name,
           domicile_country_code as u_domicile_country_code,
           incorp_country_code as u_incorp_country_code,
           bloomberg_company_id as u_bloomberg_company_id
    from party.party
    where business_date = date '2025-06-26'
) as up
    on up.u_cppib_party_id = u.underlying_cppib_party_id
left join
(
    select cppib_sec_id as underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id,
           cppib_currency_of_exposure_code as underlying_instrument_cppib_currency_of_exposure_code
    from asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
    where business_date = date '2025-06-26'
) as uf
    on uf.underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id = c.underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-25')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-25')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_infra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_infra_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset

              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-25')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-25')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_infra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency

            mp.model_portfolio

                 mp.model_portfolio,

                 asset.security_name,

with mv_raw AS (
    SELECT
        business_date,
        model_portfolio_id,
        abor_security_id,
        market_value_reporting_currency  AS mv_pc,
        market_value_quotation_currency  AS mv_qc,
        LAG(market_value_reporting_currency) OVER (
            PARTITION BY model_portfolio_id, abor_security_id
            ORDER BY business_date
        )  AS mvpc_prev,
        LAG(market_value_quotation_currency) OVER (
            PARTITION BY model_portfolio_id, abor_security_id
            ORDER BY business_date
        )  AS mvqc_prev,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY model_portfolio_id, abor_security_id
            ORDER BY business_date
        )                                                   AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY model_portfolio_id, abor_security_id
            ORDER BY business_date DESC
        )                                                   AS rn_desc    
    FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2024-12-31'  -- to replicate HERBI logic, starting market value = ending market value of previous day, and need to change start date to T-1
                           AND '2025-03-31'      
), 
start_mv AS (
    SELECT
        model_portfolio_id,
        abor_security_id,
        COALESCE(mvpc_prev, 0) AS mvpc_start,
        COALESCE(mvqc_prev, 0) AS mvqc_start
    FROM mv_raw
    WHERE rn_asc=2
),
end_mv AS (
    SELECT
        model_portfolio_id,
        abor_security_id,
        mv_pc AS mvpc_end,
        mv_qc AS mvqc_end
    FROM mv_raw
    WHERE rn_desc=1
)

            security_no,
            security_id,
            business_date,
            currency,
            SUM(pnl_currency_exposure_fx) AS fxpnl,
            sum(pnl_local_exposure_fx) as secpnl,
            sum(pnl_cad) as totpnlpc     
        FROM 
            performance.pace_holding_pnl
        GROUP BY 
            model_portfolio_code,
            security_no,
            security_id,
            business_date, 
            currency

left join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp on psl.aggregation_level_1 = mp.model_portfolio_id and mp.business_date = psl.business_date

with mv_raw AS (
    SELECT
        business_date,
        model_portfolio_id,
        abor_security_id,
        market_value_reporting_currency  AS mv_pc,
        market_value_quotation_currency  AS mv_qc,
        LAG(market_value_reporting_currency) OVER (
            PARTITION BY model_portfolio_id, abor_security_id
            ORDER BY business_date
        )  AS mvpc_prev,
        LAG(market_value_quotation_currency) OVER (
            PARTITION BY model_portfolio_id, abor_security_id
            ORDER BY business_date
        )  AS mvqc_prev,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY model_portfolio_id, abor_security_id
            ORDER BY business_date
        )                                                   AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY model_portfolio_id, abor_security_id
            ORDER BY business_date DESC
        )                                                   AS rn_desc    
    FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2024-12-31'  -- to replicate HERBI logic, starting market value = ending market value of previous day, and need to change start date to T-1
                           AND '2025-03-31'      
), 
start_mv AS (
    SELECT
        model_portfolio_id,
        abor_security_id,
        COALESCE(mvpc_prev, 0) AS mvpc_start,
        COALESCE(mvqc_prev, 0) AS mvqc_start
    FROM mv_raw
    WHERE rn_asc=2
),
end_mv AS (
    SELECT
        model_portfolio_id,
        abor_security_id,
        mv_pc AS mvpc_end,
        mv_qc AS mvqc_end
    FROM mv_raw
    WHERE rn_desc=1
)

            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
             adjusted_date AS (
                 SELECT
                     day_of_week(query_date) AS day_of_week_value,
                     CASE
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
                         ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
                         END AS business_date,
                     query_date AS original_date
                 FROM params
             ),
             final_dates AS (
                 SELECT
                     date_format(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as business_date,
                     date_format(business_date + interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d') AS as_of_date
                 FROM adjusted_date
             )
        select
            CASE
                WHEN hold.portfolio_group_id IN ('CPPIB GROUP', 'SUPPLEMENTARY', 'BCPP', 'ACPP')
                    THEN 'CPPIB GROUP'
                ELSE hold.portfolio_group_id
                END AS portfolio_group,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.portfolio_group_name IN ('CPPIB Group', 'CPPIB Supplementary', 'Base CPP', 'Additional CPP')
                    THEN 'CPPIB Group'
                ELSE hold.portfolio_group_id
                END AS portfolio_groupname,
            COALESCE(hold.portfolio_id, '') as portfolio,
            COALESCE(mp.model_portfolio_id, ' ') as mpcode,
            COALESCE(mp.model_portfolio_name, ' ') as mpname,
            COALESCE(mp.investment_department_sub_group_responsibility_code, ' ') as MPFC02,
            COALESCE(mp.sst_custody_account_code, ' ') as mpfc18,
            COALESCE(mp.sst_custody_account_name, '') as mpfc18_name,
            COALESCE(hold.security_group_id , '') as secgrp,
            COALESCE(hold.security_group_name , '') as secgrpname,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_security_type_id , '') as sectype,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_security_type_name, '') as sectypename,
            COALESCE(asi.ticker, '') as ticker,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_instrument_type, '') as instypename,
            COALESCE(asi.cusip, ' ') as cusip,
            COALESCE(CAST(asi.isin as VARCHAR), ' ') as isin,
            COALESCE(asi.sedol, ' ') as sedol,
            COALESCE(CAST(hold.cppib_sec_id as VARCHAR), ' ') as cppib_security_id,
            COALESCE(asi.bloomberg_unique_id, ' ') as bb_uniqueid_code,
            COALESCE(iss.party_group, ' ') as issuer_group,
            COALESCE(iss.party_group, ' ') as issuer_groupname,
            COALESCE(party.party_name, ' ') as issuer,
            COALESCE(iss_country.country_code, ' ') as issuercty,
            COALESCE(iss_country.country_name, ' ') as issuerctyname,
            COALESCE(port.portfolio_currency, '') as basecur,
            COALESCE(port_curr.currency_name, '') as basecurname,
            COALESCE(local_curr.currency_code, '') as localcur,
            COALESCE(local_curr.currency_name, '') as localcurname,
            COALESCE(sec.abor_exchange_id, ' ') as exchange_code,
            COALESCE(exc2.exchange_name, ' ') as exchange_name,
            COALESCE(trade_country.country_code, ' ') as tradecty,
            COALESCE(trade_country.country_name, ' ') as tradectyname,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.balance_nominal_number = CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.balance_nominal_number AS BIGINT) as VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.balance_nominal_number * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS balnomval,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.clean_price = CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.clean_price AS INT) AS VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS cleanqc,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.abor_maturity_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as matdate,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_maturity_date, '') as matdate_caroni,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(hold.business_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as todate,
            COALESCE(hold.business_date, '') as todate_caroni,
            COALESCE(hold.abor_security_number, '') as security_no,
            ' ' as murex_port_code,
            COALESCE(und.sedol_id, '') as sedol_underly,
            COALESCE(und.isin_id, '') as isin_underly,
            COALESCE(und.bloomberg_unique_id, '') as bb_underly,
            CASE
                WHEN hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency = CAST(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS INT)
                    THEN CAST(CAST(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS INT) as VARCHAR)
                ELSE TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(FLOOR(hold.clean_price * hold.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency
                    * POWER(10, 9)) / POWER(10, 9) AS DECIMAL(38, 9)) AS VARCHAR))
                END AS cleanpc,
            COALESCE(CONCAT(sec.abor_issue_date, 'T00:00:00.000-0400'), '') as issue_date,
            COALESCE(sec.abor_issue_date, '') as issue_date_caroni,
            COALESCE(CAST(cast(repo.repo_nominal as BIGINT) as VARCHAR), '0') as repo_nominal,
            COALESCE(und.abor_security_number, '') as secno_underly
        from holdings.scd_holdings_main hold
                 join final_dates fd on hold.business_date = fd.business_date
                 left join holdings.repo_holdings_details repo on hold.business_date = date_format(repo.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') and hold.scd_holding_key_id = repo.id_source_holding
                 left join reference.scd_model_portfolio mp on hold.business_date = mp.business_date and hold.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
                 left join reference.scd_portfolio port on hold.portfolio_id = port.portfolio_id and hold.business_date = port.business_date
                 left join asset.asset_security_identifiers asi on hold.business_date = date_format(asi.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
            and hold.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
                 left join party.party party on party.cppib_party_id = asi.cppib_party_id and date_format(party.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
                 left join (select id_cppib_party, max(party_group) as party_group
                            from reference.scd_party_issuer iss
                                     join final_dates fd on iss.business_date = fd.business_date
                            group by id_cppib_party) iss
                           on iss.id_cppib_party = cast(party.cppib_party_id as varchar)
                 left join reference.scd_securities sec on sec.abor_security_number = hold.abor_security_number and sec.business_date = hold.business_date
                 left join reference.scd_securities und on sec.abor_underlying_instrument_id = und.scd_security_key_id and sec.business_date = und.business_date
                 left join reference.reference_country_codes iss_country on iss_country.country_code = party.domicile_country_code
            and iss_country.business_date = party.business_date
                 left join reference.reference_country_codes trade_country on trade_country.country_code = sec.abor_country_id
            and date_format(trade_country.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
                 left join reference.reference_currency_codes port_curr on date_format(port_curr.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
            and port_curr.currency_code = port.portfolio_currency
                 left join reference.reference_currency_codes local_curr on date_format(local_curr.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = hold.business_date
            and local_curr.currency_code = hold.quotation_currency_code
                 left join
                     (select exchange_id, max(exchange_name) as exchange_name
                      from (select mic as exchange_id, max(mic_name) as exchange_name
                            from reference.reference_exchange_codes exc
                                     join final_dates fd on date_format(exc.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = fd.business_Date
                            group by mic
                            union
                            select exchange_code as exchange_id, max(vendor_exchange_name) as exchange_name
                            from reference.reference_exchange_codes_map
                            group by exchange_code
                            union
                            select 'INT' as exchange_code, 'Internal' as exchange_name)
                      group by exchange_id
                     ) as exc2
                     on exc2.exchange_id = sec.abor_exchange_id
        where (hold.balance_nominal_number != 0 or
                hold.balance_nominal_number_unsettled != 0 or
                hold.clean_value_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.next_dividend_quotation_currency != 0 or
                hold.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency != 0)) T LIMIT 0

			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 17 and 18
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 17:53:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

		PARENT.domicile_country_code AS COUNTRY_CODE,
		max(parent.SOVR_FI_LIMIT) AS SOVR_FI_LIMIT
	FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity CHILD,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity PARENT,
		risk_prod.DIM_CR_EXP_POS_INST pos
	where FACT.chron_id = bd.chron_id
		AND FACT.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
		AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		AND CHILD.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = PARENT.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
		AND IS_POS_FI = 'Y'
		AND (PARENT.SOVR_FI_LIMIT IS NOT NULL)
	GROUP BY PARENT.domicile_country_code
),
CE_LE_SN AS (
	SELECT PARENT.party_name,
		sum(coalesce(FACT.ACPP_credit_exposure, 0)) AS acpp_credit_exposure,
		sum(coalesce(FACT.BCPP_credit_exposure, 0)) AS bcpp_credit_exposure,
		MAX(PARENT.gics_sector) AS SECTOR,
		MAX(regexp_extract(PARENT.rtg_final, '^[A-D]{1,3}')) AS RATING,
		MAX(
			CASE
				WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y'
				AND upper(PARENT.party_name) LIKE 'PROVINCE OF ONTARIO%%' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.15
				WHEN PARENT.is_government = 'Y'
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N'
				AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA')
				AND upper(PARENT.party_name) IN ('UNITED STATES OF AMERICA', 'CANADA') THEN 0
				/* no limit */
				WHEN upper(PARENT.party_name) IN ('CPP FI') THEN 0
				WHEN PARENT.rtg_final IS NULL THEN -1

				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.1
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.075
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.05
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.03
				when regexp_like(parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' then a_pv.pv * 0.025
				/* BB and below */
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.15
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.10
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.075
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.05
				when regexp_like(parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' then a_pv.pv * 0.025
				/* BB and below */
				ELSE -2
				/* Breach it big time, to indicate that a case was missed */
			END
		) AS ACPP_LIMIT,
		MAX(
			CASE
				WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y'
				AND upper(PARENT.party_name) LIKE 'PROVINCE OF ONTARIO%%' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.15
				WHEN PARENT.is_government = 'Y'
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N'
				AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA')
				AND upper(PARENT.party_name) IN ('UNITED STATES OF AMERICA', 'CANADA') THEN 0
				/* no limit */
				WHEN upper(PARENT.party_name) IN ('CPP FI') THEN 0

				/* cannot tell, so no limit */
				when regexp_like(parent.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' then b_pv.pv * 0.1
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.075
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.05
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.03
				when regexp_like(parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' then b_pv.pv * 0.025
				/* BB and below */
				when regexp_like(parent.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' then b_pv.pv * 0.15
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.1
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.075
				WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.05
				when regexp_like(parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)')
				AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' then b_pv.pv * 0.025
				/* BB and below */
				ELSE -2
				/* Breach it big time, to indicate that a case was missed */
			END
		) AS BCPP_LIMIT
	FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity CHILD,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity PARENT,
		ACPP_PV a_pv,
		BCPP_PV b_pv
	where fact.chron_id = bd.chron_id
		AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		/* Exclude all north american government positions */
	GROUP BY PARENT.party_name

WITH latest_meta_run_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(df_meta_run_date) AS max_run_date
    FROM df_trusted_prod.markit_credit_index_component
    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
),
latest_file_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(file_date) AS max_file_date
    FROM market.markit_credit_index
    WHERE SUBSTRING(index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
)
SELECT
    idx.index_family,
    idx.index_name,
    idx.annex_date,
    idx.index_series,
    idx.index_version,
    idx.index_factor,
    comp.index_clip,
    comp.component_ref_entity_ticker,
    comp.component_ref_entity_name,
    comp.component_ref_entity_red,
    comp.component_ref_entity_record_date,
    comp.component_ref_entity_type,
    comp.component_ref_entity_weight AS component_weight,
    comp.component_coupon_type,
    comp.component_currency,
    comp.component_maturity,
    comp.component_coupon,
    evt.red_entity_code,
    evt.reference_entity,
    evt.ticker,
    evt.cerrd AS event_determination_date,
    evt.corporateaction_event_date,
    evt.default_date,
    evt.type,
    evt.event_type,
    evt.auction_date,
    evt.tier_name,
    evt.auction_price,
    evt.auction_cash_settlement_date AS settlement_date

JOIN market.markit_credit_event_details_latest AS evt
    ON comp.component_ref_entity_red = evt.red_entity_code
JOIN market.markit_credit_index AS idx
    ON idx.index_clip = comp.index_clip
WHERE
    comp.df_meta_run_date = (SELECT max_run_date FROM latest_meta_run_date)
    AND idx.file_date = (SELECT max_file_date FROM latest_file_date)
    AND SUBSTRING(comp.index_clip, 1, 6) = '2I65BY'
    AND evt.auction_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    idx.index_series ASC, idx.index_version ASC, comp.component_ref_entity_ticker ASC

/* cppi::4e53036083934eae00146c87f06e1d67d872e79610c5ca90d8a8647e4acde813 */
SELECT
    red_code as index_red_code,
    MIN(business_date) as trading_start_date,
    MAX(business_date) as trading_end_date,
    index_name as index_ticker,
    index_series as series,
    index_version as version,
    index_term as tenor
FROM market.markit_credit_index_composite
WHERE
    1=1
    AND composite_spread is not null
    AND index_name in ('iTraxx Eur Xover')
    AND index_term in ('5Y')
    AND on_the_run = 'Y'
GROUP BY
    red_code, index_name, index_series, index_version, index_term
ORDER BY
    index_name ASC, index_series ASC, index_version ASC

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
             adjusted_date AS (
                 SELECT
                     query_date,
                     CASE
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
                         ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
                         END AS business_date
                 FROM params
             ),
             account_mapping_query AS (
                 SELECT
                     date_format(pam.as_of_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                 WHERE pam.as_of_date BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                           AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
             ),
             unioned_data AS (
                 select COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM account_mapping_query

                 UNION

                 SELECT
                     scd.business_date AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 WHERE CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                     AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
                   and NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM account_mapping_query fq
                     WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
                       AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
                 )
             ),
             daily_counts AS (
                 SELECT business_date, COUNT(*) AS record_count
                 FROM unioned_data
                 GROUP BY business_date
             ),
             average_count AS (
                 SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
                 FROM daily_counts
             )
        SELECT cast(avg_count as varchar) FROM average_count) T LIMIT 0

SELECT

	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 02 and 03
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 02:05:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	),
	fin as (
        select
            fin.*,
            row_number() over (
                        partition by
                            fin.gl_account_id,
                            fin.gl_transaction_number,
                            fin.finance_transaction_index,
                            fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key,  -- same transaction number can have different primary key
                            fin.booking_type
                        order by
                            fin.extract_time desc
                   ) as rn
        from
            finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        where
            fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'

            id_model_portfolio,

                    partition by id_model_portfolio
        order by

		trans.quotation_currency as "Quoted Currency Code - Transaction",
		fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency as "Sum Finance Trans. - Debit Amount PC",
		fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency as "Sum Finance Trans. - Credit Amount PC",
		fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency as "Sum Finance Trans. - Debit Amount QC",

		trans.payment_amount_quotation_currency as "Sum Net Proceeds QC",
		trans.transaction_cancellation_flag as "Transaction Cancellation Flag Name",
		fin.cost_name as "Cost Name",
		fin.gl_transaction_number as "fin transaction number",
		trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
		fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
	from
		mp
	left join trans
		on
		trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.id_model_portfolio
	left join fin
	    on
		trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
		and fin.rn = 1

		trans.rn = 1
	    AND trans.abor_security_id NOT LIKE 'DUMMY%'
    	AND trans.elementary_transaction_code NOT IN ('BalBook','EOP adj.')
		and mp.rn = 1
		and trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
		and fin.gl_account_id is not null
	order by
		trans.payment_date asc,

		trans.model_portfolio_id,
		trans.business_transaction_code,
		fin.gl_account_name

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
             adjusted_date AS (
                 SELECT
                     query_date,
                     CASE
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
                         ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
                         END AS business_date
                 FROM params
             ),
             account_mapping_query AS (
                 SELECT
                     date_format(pam.as_of_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                 WHERE pam.as_of_date BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                           AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
             ),
             unioned_data AS (
                 select COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM account_mapping_query

                 UNION

                 SELECT
                     scd.business_date AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 WHERE CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                     AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
                   and NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM account_mapping_query fq
                     WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
                       AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
                 )
             ),
             daily_counts AS (
                 SELECT business_date, COUNT(*) AS record_count
                 FROM unioned_data
                 GROUP BY business_date
             ),
             average_count AS (
                 SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
                 FROM daily_counts
             )
        SELECT cast(avg_count as varchar) FROM average_count) T LIMIT 0

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 22 and 23
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 22:25:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000
